notes.title: Polity - Online Role Playing - v3.1.1: Changelog
notes.content:
Polity is heading into a new era! With a brand new update, we invite you to the world of Polity, where a whole new adventure awaits. Embark on a year-long journey through Polity's story, exploring the colonies that will be unlocked every month.

This new era offers an exciting experience where you can travel between countries to complete special missions and collect achievement badges. Each month a new country will open its doors and you will immerse yourself in these unique cultures and shape your own journey. By becoming a citizen, you can take up a profession, go fishing, interact with NPCs and make new friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40214676/48acfd6e9d4677805f27883b6fc5ea5deb65d322.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the new era of Polity! ☕

New Content:

🚀Two story lands
🚀95 different NPC characters
🚀6 different achievements and badges
🚀28 main tasks
🚀7 different puzzles
🚀Fishing

General Updates and Improvements:

🚀Main gameplay and camera angles have been changed.
🚀Bug fixes and performance optimizations.
🚀Made various balancing adjustments to improve the gameplay experience.

notes.title: Changing Polity from Paid to Free Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Citizens of BD-2 and the Future Citizens,

[i]We are happy to announce that we are going to make Polity FREE again![/i]

First of all, we want to thank all Early Birds for supporting Polity and making it our game. We were always planning to change the game from paid to free (after a certain period), but, later, we decided not to postpone it to reach everyone who desires to give a chance to Polity. The upcoming change will have enriched the atmosphere of BD-2 and diversified the citizen profile to experience this planet and the existing player-generated countries. It will bring new players who are future citizens together with the current citizens on BD-2 to build their utopia more strongly. The change will happen around a week later.

[b]The Early Birds (Players who purchased the game) and the new citizens will have differences:[/b]
[list]
[*] The new players won’t receive any Diamond currency (until levelling up in the game) when they first start the game as a citizen. 
[*] They won’t receive any badges or head emojis, which belong to the DLCs or the Early Birds (unless they purchased one).
[/list]

[i]Thanks to everyone who is a part of our journey and supports us; your feedback and existence in our community mean a lot to us![/i]




                                                                                                         POLITY DEVELOPMENT TEAM
